Footer shows 0414 698 435 + ABN 62 137 127 557. ONE DESIGN ISSUE FOUND: /repairs hero on desktop widescreens crops the technician portrait image (1086x1448) so aggressively (object-cover object-top on 1920x626 hero strip = only top 24.4% of source shown) that the technician is not visible at all — only ceiling and a downlight are shown. Home service-card-3 (Maintenance & Repairs, 554x346 crop) shows top ~47% of source: head/top of technician just barely visible with body cut off. The acceptance criterion 'technician on ladder (professionally cropped, not cutting off the technician)' is NOT satisfied on wide desktop /repairs hero.

issues: PageHero strip (~1920x626) with object-cover + object-top on portrait technician image (natural 1086x1448) reveals only ~24% of the source from top. Actual visible content: white ceiling + downlight — the technician on ladder is NOT visible at all on widescreen. Requirement: 'technician on ladder professionally cropped, not cutting off the technician.'

Home service-card-3 (Maintenance & Repairs) 16:10 crop (554x346) reveals ~47% of source from top: only the very top of the technician + AC unit visible; technician's body is cut off. Better than /repairs hero but still shows the same issue at smaller scale.

Recommended fixes (main agent): (a) use a differently-cropped landscape technician image for the hero, or (b) let PageHero use aspect-[4/3] instead of aspect-[16/5] on this page, or (c) shift objectPosition to focus around the technician (e.g. '50% 40%' if technician is centered vertically), or (d) use CSS background-image with contain + neutral surround, or (e) reduce hero height and letterbox the image.

rca of the issue: ROOT CAUSE (/repairs hero cropping): The technician source image is a 1086x1448 portrait (aspect 0.75) where the technician stands roughly in the middle-lower portion of the frame. PageHero renders a wide strip (~1920x626, aspect ~3.07) with object-cover object-top. object-cover scales the image to fill width -> scaled dimensions 1920x2560. object-top then shows only the top 626px (top 24.4%) of that scaled canvas — which corresponds to the top 24% of the original image, i.e. the ceiling above the technician. REPRO STEPS: (1) Open https://splitspro-preview.preview.emergentagent.com/repairs on desktop 1920x1080; (2) Observe hero strip shows a white ceiling with a downlight — no person visible. MITIGATION OPTIONS (for main agent): (a) source a landscape-crop of the technician photo (1920x800 wide with technician centered), (b) change /repairs PageHero to aspect-[4/3] and center on technician with object-position '50% 50%', (c) use object-position like '50% 40%' after measuring where in the source the technician's head sits, or (d) tighten the hero height (h-[70vh] with object-position tuned) so more of the source shows.
